NONE: › because the number of people or things was so great

example: The crowd managed to force its way in by sheer weight of numbers.
這群人依靠人多勢眾，強行擠了進來。

NONE: › If a person or animal wins a race or competition by a nose, he, she, or it wins it by very little.

example: It was a very exciting race. My horse won but only by a nose.
比賽結束得驚心動魄，我的馬以微弱優勢獲得了勝利。
Last time she raced against the Brazilian, she won by a whisker.
上次她和那個巴西人賽跑，僅以微弱優勢取勝。
"May I borrow this book?" "By all means."
「我可以借這本書嗎？」「當然可以。」
By and by a man appeared.
過了一會兒，有一個人出現了。
You'll get used to it by and by.
不久你就會習慣的。

NONE: C1 when everything about a situation is considered together
大體上，總體上，一般來講

example: There are a few small things that I don't like about my job, but by and large it's very enjoyable.
雖然有些小的地方讓我不太滿意，但總的來講我還是很喜歡這份工作的。
The economy seems to be improving by degrees.
經濟似乎在逐步好轉。

NONE: › If you try to achieve something by fair means or foul, you use any method you can to achieve it, even if it is not honest or fair.

example: By gum, he's a big lad!
好傢夥，他塊頭真大啊！

NONE: 想方設法，千方百計，不擇手段

example: I decided I was going to get that job by hook or by crook.
我下定決心無論如何都要得到那份工作。
The car skidded and I avoided the dog by inches (= I very nearly hit the dog).
汽車打滑，我差點撞到那隻狗。
It is by no means certain that we'll finish the project by June.
我們能否在六月份前完成這項工程還很難確定。
This isn't the last we'll hear of it by any means.
這絕對不會是我們最後一次聽到此事。

NONE: › used to describe things that are definitely not possible or correct

example: By no stretch of the imagination could he be seriously described as an artist.
無論如何也難以相信人們會認真地稱他為藝術家。
This could not by any stretch be seen as a victory.
怎麼也無法把這想像成一場勝利。

NONE: › done according to a plan that has been decided previously, without using your own imagination and ideas
機械地，死板地，按部就班地

example: This is painting by numbers - there's nothing original here.
這是一幅很死板的畫——毫無新意。

NONE: › not directly, by hearing what other people say

example: The two men know each other only by reputation.
這兩個人只是彼此聽說過。
She spoke first, by right of her position as director.
因為她是董事，所以先發言。
By rights, it should be my turn next.
按理說，下一個該輪到我了。

NONE: › judging by the information we have now

example: By the look of things, we won't finish till next week.
從現在的情況看，我們要到下個星期才能做完。

NONE: C2 used to mean that something you are about to say is also true, for the same reasons as what has just been said
同理，同樣地，由於同樣的原因

example: I don't think that prices will go up but, by the same token, I don't see them going down either.
我認爲價格不會上漲，同樣，我也認爲價格不會下跌。

NONE: › If you do something by the seat of your pants, you do it using only your own experience and trusting your own judgment.
› If you do something by the skin of your teeth, you only just succeed in doing it.

example: He escaped from the secret police by the skin of his teeth.
他從秘密警察手裡僥倖逃脫。

NONE: A2 used to introduce a new subject to be considered or to give further information

example: I think we've discussed everything we need to - by the way, what time is it?
我想需要討論的每個問題，我們都談過了——順便問一下，現在是甚麼時間？
Oh, by the way, my name's Julie.
噢，順便說一下，我叫祖莉。
He sent me some flowers by way of an apology.
他送一些花給我，表示歉意。

NONE: › in speech but not in writing

example: All the orders were given by word of mouth so that no written evidence could be discovered later.
所有命令都是口頭傳達的，所以事後找不到任何書面證據。

NONE: › in the UK, an election that happens at a different time from a main election, to choose a Member of Parliament to replace one who has died or left his or her job
› to learn something in such a way that you can say it from memory
B2 learned in such a way that you can repeat it from memory

example: My father can still recite the poems he learned by heart at school.
我父親仍能背誦出他以前唸書時背下來的詩。

NONE: › something that is produced as a result of making something else, or something unexpected that happens as a result of something
副産品；附帶産生的後果

example: Buttermilk is a by-product of making butter.
脫脂牛奶是製造奶油時的副産品。
Illness is one of the by-products of overcrowded housing.
居住環境過度擁擠的後果之一是滋生疾病。

NONE: C2 If someone or something gets better by/in leaps and bounds, he, she, or it improves very quickly.

example: Her Spanish has come on (= improved) in leaps and bounds this year.
今年她的西班牙語水準提高得很快。
